tools.name: merron_get_questions
tools.description: Get relevant business questions and explanations for a selected AI system. Pass only known user answers; omit unknown values or use null. Does not classify or assume unanswered questions mean No. No sign-in or private workspace access.

tools.name: merron_screen_ai_act
tools.description: Run Merron's versioned, bounded AI Act rules on facts the user has explicitly confirmed. Returns a conditional screening result, unresolved routes, missing questions and official references. Never infer confirmation or legal compliance from source code or absence of signals. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: merron_scan_project · Private data: merron_scan_project, merron_get_questions, merron_screen_ai_act, merron_prepare_workspace · Public sink: merron_scan_project · Destructive: merron_scan_project, merron_screen_ai_act.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: merron_scan_project · Private data: merron_scan_project, merron_get_questions, merron_screen_ai_act, merron_prepare_workspace · Public sink: merron_scan_project · Destructive: merron_scan_project, merron_screen_ai_act

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
